t: Greetings on Tax Authority Worker’s Day

t: Greetings to the participants, organisers and guests of the International Conference on Public Health in Africa
d: Vladimir Putin sent a message of greetings to the participants, organisers and guests of the international conference in Addis Ababa on issues related to ensuring the real sovereignty of African countries in public health.
